title: The Vector of Kepler Reach
author: Beatrix Ishikawa
blurb: Edmund Yarrow, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
